payload.title: Improve large-project open/save and media performance around Smart Shorts; deploy
payload.description: Audit remaining measurable latency around canonical sessions, playback and export. Implement bounded optimizations with preserved canonical semantics and project data, regression checks, performance evidence and production activation.
acceptance: Reduce verified large-project open/save or media bottlenecks without losing edits/history/transcript
Canonical auth, revision, idempotency and validation stay enforced
Regression checks and before/after evidence pass
Deploy verified production release and confirm host healthy
